newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AFTER DULL FRIDAY.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS WEEK MIXED AFTER DULL FRIDAY.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed the week mixed against hard currencies after a lacklustre Friday on the interbank market.
"It was a very quiet market. It was almost like we were not there at all," one dealer commented.
He said the local unit only slipped once during the day to 10.9575/9725 against the key U.S. unit before settling back to close at 10.9550/9700, the same levels it finished at on Thursday.

Against the crosses however, it tracked a firmer U.S. unit overseas and ended the day at 17.5700/6100 against sterling, up from 17.7510/7880 previously, but was quoted easier at 6.7000/7200 versus the mark from 6.6750/6880. Against the rand, it closed at 2.4000/4100, slight down from 2.3970/4030.
